# LARGE UNIFORM BACILLI IN AN AEROBIC BOTTLE

Large uniform bacilli in an aerobic bottle usually suggest Bacillus species.

Bacillus subtilis is usually a contaminant, Bacillus cereus is uncommon but usually pathogenic. If Bacillus anthracis is suspected or isolated contact Infectious Diseases immediately.

References

- Hendricks et al., Emerg Infect Dis 2014, 20.2
- Medical Letter Choice of Antimicrobials 2010, 8.94
- Up-to-Date article: Bacillus cereus and other non-anthracis Bacillus species
Therapy:
## Empirical treatment of suspected non-anthracis Bacillus spp. associated with disease

[Vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h \(Cost $\) R](orz-set-abx-vanco-new-start-15mg-kg-q12h-mrsa-nares-screening)

## Empirical treatment of suspected Bacillus anthracis

## Start combination therapy and contact Infectious Diseases immediately.

## If meningitis has not been ruled out

Treat for 6 weeks
[Ciprofloxacin 400 mg IV q8h \(Cost $\) R,DI <AND> Meropenem 2 gm IV q8h](orz-set-abx-cipro-400-q8h-mero-2-q8h-linezolid-600-q12h)
(Cost $$) [R,O] < AND > linezolid 600 mg IV q12h (Cost $$$$) [DI]

## If meningitis has been ruled out

Isolate is penicillin-susceptible
[Penicillin 4 million units IV q4H \(Cost $$\) R,DI <AND> clindamycin 900mg](orz-set-abx-penici-4mu-iv-q4h-clinda-900mg-iv-q8h)
IV q8h (Cost $$) [H,O]

Isolate is not penicillin susceptible or susceptibility unknown
[Ciprofloxacin 400 mg IV q8h \(Cost $\) R,DI <AND> clindamycin 900mg IV q8h](orz-set-abx-cipro-400mg-iv-q8h-clinda-900mg-iv-q8h)
(Cost $$) [H,O]
